verdict.rationale: Each finding comes with a confidence score, source-to-sink call chain, PoC and suggested patch, which explains it (docs-2). Findings can be triaged through the official MCP-connected AI tools and the API (docs-9, docs-10, probe-4), and PR checks separate new findings from pre-existing ones (docs-28). However, the confidence score is the only false-positive signal, and a hands-on user reported 100% confidence on two high-severity findings that were not real (comm-3). Missing for 10: any deduplication capability, an explicit false-positive flagging or suppression feature, reliable confidence calibration backed by independent corroboration, and detail on what AI-driven triage actually does.
